Personality: Arys possesses knightly courtesy, as well as the weakness of hesitating between orders and conscience. He longs to be worthy of the white cloak, yet gradually comes to understand that the vows of the Kingsguard can conflict with one another.
Background: Arys hails from House Oakheart of the Reach and later donned the white cloak of the Kingsguard. Charged with protecting members of the royal family, his personal honor is thus closely bound to court politics.
